import json, urllib.request, ssl

ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
prom = "http://10.10.20.30:9090"

def prom_query(expr):
    try:
        url = f"{prom}/api/v1/query?query={urllib.request.quote(expr)}"
        req = urllib.request.Request(url)
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        return data.get("data", {}).get("result", [])
    except Exception as e:
        return []

# Host health (up metric from node_exporter â€” jobs end in -node)
up_results = prom_query('up{job=~".*-node"}')
hosts_up = sum(1 for r in up_results if r["value"][1] == "1")
hosts_total = len(up_results)

# Blackbox service health (blackbox-http and blackbox-icmp)
svc_results = prom_query('probe_success{job=~"blackbox-.*"}')
svcs_up = sum(1 for r in svc_results if r["value"][1] == "1")
svcs_total = len(svc_results)

# Worst disk usage (all node exporter targets, root mount)
disk_results = prom_query('100 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="tmpfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="tmpfs"} * 100)')
worst_disk = "N/A"
worst_pct = 0
for r in disk_results:
    pct = float(r["value"][1])
    job = r["metric"].get("job", "unknown")
    host = job.replace("-node", "") if job.endswith("-node") else r["metric"].get("instance", "unknown")
    if pct > worst_pct:
        worst_pct = pct
        worst_disk = f"{host} ({pct:.0f}%)"

section = f"INFRASTRUCTURE\\nHosts: {hosts_up}/{hosts_total} HEALTHY\\nServices: {svcs_up}/{svcs_total} UP\\nDisk Watch: {worst_disk}"
print(json.dumps({"section": section}))

import json, datetime, urllib.request, re

today = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

results = self.full_execution.get("results", []) if isinstance(self.full_execution, dict) else []

section_map = {}
haccp_embed = None
for r in results:
    label = r.get("action", {}).get("label", "")
    if label in ("security_data", "infra_data", "overnight_data"):
        try:
            p = json.loads(r.get("result", "{}"))
            msg = p.get("message", p) if isinstance(p, dict) else p
            if isinstance(msg, str):
                msg = json.loads(msg)
            section_map[label] = msg.get("section", str(msg))
        except:
            section_map[label] = label + ": parse error"
    elif label == "haccp_briefing":
        try:
            p = json.loads(r.get("result", "{}"))
            msg = p.get("message", p) if isinstance(p, dict) else p
            if isinstance(msg, str):
                msg = json.loads(msg)
            section_map["haccp_briefing"] = msg.get("stats_line", "HACCP: data unavailable")
            haccp_embed = msg.get("embed", None)
        except:
            section_map["haccp_briefing"] = "HACCP: parse error"

raw_sections = []
for lbl in ["security_data", "infra_data", "overnight_data"]:
    raw_sections.append(section_map.get(lbl, lbl + ": data unavailable"))

haccp_stats = section_map.get("haccp_briefing", "HACCP: data unavailable")
all_data = " | ".join(raw_sections) + " | " + haccp_stats
if len(all_data) > 3000:
    all_data = all_data[:3000]

def _int(pat, text, default=0):
    m = re.search(pat, text)
    if not m:
        return default
    try:
        v = m.group(1)
        return int(v) if v is not None else default
    except (ValueError, IndexError, TypeError):
        return default

sec_text = section_map.get("security_data", "")
infra_text = section_map.get("infra_data", "")
over_text = section_map.get("overnight_data", "")
haccp_text = section_map.get("haccp_briefing", "")

crit_n = _int(r"\((\d+)\s*crit", sec_text)
high_n = _int(r",\s*(\d+)\s*high", sec_text)
alerts_n = _int(r"Alerts:\s*(\d+)", sec_text)
cases_n = _int(r"Open Cases:\s*(\d+)", sec_text)
top_rule_m = re.search(r"Top Rule:\s*([^\n|]+)", sec_text)
top_rule = top_rule_m.group(1).strip() if top_rule_m else "unknown"

hosts_m = re.search(r"Hosts:\s*(\d+)/(\d+)\s*HEALTHY", infra_text)
hosts_down = (int(hosts_m.group(2)) - int(hosts_m.group(1))) if hosts_m else 0
svcs_m = re.search(r"Services:\s*(\d+)/(\d+)\s*UP", infra_text)
svcs_down = (int(svcs_m.group(2)) - int(svcs_m.group(1))) if svcs_m else 0
disk_m = re.search(r"Disk Watch:\s*(\S+)\s*\((\d+)%\)", infra_text)
disk_host = disk_m.group(1) if disk_m else "?"
disk_pct = int(disk_m.group(2)) if disk_m else 0

ti_iocs = _int(r"Threat Intel IOCs[^:]*:\s*(\d+)", over_text)
ml_flag = bool(re.search(r"high-score", over_text, re.IGNORECASE)) and not re.search(r"No\s+high-score", over_text, re.IGNORECASE)

haccp_events = _int(r"HACCP:\s*(\d+)\s*events", haccp_text)
haccp_ti = _int(r"(\d+)\s*TI\s*match", haccp_text)
haccp_novel = _int(r"(\d+)\s*novel", haccp_text)

callouts = []
if crit_n > 0:
    callouts.append(f"{crit_n} critical alert(s) last 24h, top rule '{top_rule}' - review required")
if high_n >= 500:
    callouts.append(f"{high_n} high-severity alerts against {cases_n} open cases - triage may be lagging")
if haccp_ti > 0:
    callouts.append(f"{haccp_ti} threat-intel match(es) on haccp - pull indicator context")
if haccp_novel >= 1000:
    callouts.append(f"Tier-2 novelty elevated: {haccp_novel} novel entities - verify against expected baseline")
if disk_pct >= 80:
    callouts.append(f"Disk {disk_host} at {disk_pct}% - investigate")
if hosts_down > 0:
    callouts.append(f"{hosts_down} host(s) not healthy")
if svcs_down > 0:
    callouts.append(f"{svcs_down} service(s) down")
if ml_flag:
    callouts.append("ML anomaly detector flagged high-score event(s)")
if cases_n >= 10:
    callouts.append(f"Open case backlog at {cases_n} - consider triage sweep")

if callouts:
    mandatory_block = "MANDATORY CALLOUTS (each must appear in your output):\n" + "\n".join("- " + c for c in callouts)
    directive = "Lead the Action line with these callouts verbatim or near-verbatim."
else:
    mandatory_block = "MANDATORY CALLOUTS: (none triggered - thresholds all clear)"
    directive = "No thresholds fired. On the Action line, name TWO specific numbers or observations you verified as normal (e.g. 'verified: 5/5 hosts healthy, 21/21 services up'). Do NOT use the phrases 'steady state', 'all clear', or 'no action required'."

def sanitize(s):
    s = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", s, flags=re.DOTALL)
    s = s.replace(chr(92), "").replace(chr(34), chr(39)).replace(chr(13), "").replace(chr(9), " ")
    s = "".join(c for c in s if ord(c) >= 32)
    return s.strip()

prompt_parts = [
    "/no_think You are the SOC watch officer writing the morning briefing for a homelab SOC.",
    "",
    mandatory_block,
    "",
    directive,
    "",
    "OUTPUT: four lines, plain text, no markdown, no preamble. Each line begins with its label:",
    "Security: [alert counts, critical/high, open cases, top rule if notable]",
    "Infrastructure: [host/service/disk state; call out any non-nominal value]",
    "Notable: [threat intel IOCs, ML anomaly state, HACCP events/TI/novel]",
    "Action: [per directive above]",
    "",
    "CONSTRAINTS: present tense, specific numbers, no filler, no editorializing, no platitudes like 'continued vigilance recommended'.",
    "",
    "DATA: " + all_data,
]
prompt = "\n".join(prompt_parts)

assessment = ""
try:
    payload = json.dumps({
        "model": "qwen3:8b",
        "prompt": prompt,
        "system": "You are a SOC watch officer. Write in short declarative sentences. Be specific about numbers and hostnames. Never emit 'steady state', 'no action required', or similar boilerplate.",
        "stream": False,
        "think": False,
        "keep_alive": "24h",
        "options": {"temperature": 0.2}
    }).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request("$ollama_url/api/generate",
        data=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180)
    text = json.loads(resp.read().decode()).get("response", "")
    text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
    text = text.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "")
    if not text:
        retry_payload = json.dumps({
            "model": "qwen3:8b",
            "prompt": "/no_think " + prompt.replace("/no_think ", ""),
            "stream": False, "think": False, "keep_alive": "24h",
            "options": {"temperature": 0.2}
        }).encode()
        retry_req = urllib.request.Request("$ollama_url/api/generate",
            data=retry_payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        retry_resp = urllib.request.urlopen(retry_req, timeout=180)
        text = json.loads(retry_resp.read().decode()).get("response", "")
        text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
        text = text.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "")
    if text:
        assessment = sanitize(text)
    else:
        assessment = "Watch officer assessment unavailable."
except Exception as e:
    assessment = "LLM unavailable: " + str(e)[:60]

NL = chr(92) + "n"
header = "**MORNING BRIEFING -- " + today + "**"
parts = [header, "---", "__Watch Officer Assessment__", assessment, "---"]
for s in raw_sections:
    parts.append(s)
    parts.append("---")

body = NL.join(parts)
if len(body) > 1950:
    body = body[:1947] + "..."

result = {"content": body, "haccp_embed": haccp_embed}
print(json.dumps(result))

import json, datetime, io

try:
    import paramiko
    key_str = """$haccp_ssh_key"""
    key = paramiko.Ed25519Key.from_private_key(io.StringIO(key_str))
    ssh = paramiko.SSHClient()
    ssh.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
    ssh.connect("10.10.30.25", username="bchaplow", pkey=key, timeout=10)
    today = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    path = "/opt/elk/briefing/haccp-nightly-" + today + ".json"
    stdin, stdout, stderr = ssh.exec_command("cat " + path)
    raw = stdout.read().decode()
    ssh.close()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    summary = data.get("summary", "")
    summary = summary.replace(chr(10), " ").replace(chr(13), " ").replace(chr(92), "").replace(chr(34), chr(39)).strip()
    stats = data.get("stats_summary", {})
    total = stats.get("total_events", 0)
    tags = stats.get("tags", [])
    tier1 = next((t[1] for t in tags if t[0] == "tier1_ti_match"), 0)
    tier2 = next((t[1] for t in tags if t[0] == "tier2_novel"), 0)
    if len(summary) > 3900:
        summary = summary[:3900].rsplit(" ", 1)[0] + "..."
    stats_line = "HACCP: " + str(total) + " events, " + str(tier1) + " TI matches, " + str(tier2) + " novel"
    embed = {
        "title": "HACCP Zeek Network (" + today + ")",
        "description": summary,
        "color": 15105570,
        "fields": [
            {"name": "Events", "value": str(total), "inline": True},
            {"name": "TI Matches", "value": str(tier1), "inline": True},
            {"name": "Novel", "value": str(tier2), "inline": True}
        ],
        "footer": {"text": "/opt/elk/briefing/haccp-nightly-" + today + ".json"}
    }
    result = {"stats_line": stats_line, "embed": embed}
except Exception as e:
    today = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    stats_line = "HACCP: briefing unavailable -- " + str(e)[:80]
    embed = {
        "title": "HACCP Zeek Network (" + today + ")",
        "description": "Briefing unavailable: " + str(e)[:200],
        "color": 15158332,
        "footer": {"text": "/opt/elk/briefing/haccp-nightly-" + today + ".json"}
    }
    result = {"stats_line": stats_line, "embed": embed}

print(json.dumps(result))
